title: The Attention Economy
description: Follow the development of attention mechanisms from a translation trick to the dominant paradigm in AI. Trace the line from seq2seq through Transformers to GPT-4 and beyond.
targetAudience: Those wanting to understand how modern LLMs work
keyTakeaways: Attention lets models focus on relevant parts of input dynamically
Transformers process all positions in parallel, enabling massive scale
Scaling laws predict performance improvements from larger models
ChatGPT made AI accessible to 100 million users in 2 months
